item.title: Children of Heaven Review – Cinema-ye do zabaane | English & Farsi Podcast
item.description: For the first episode of Cinema-ye Do Zabaane, a film made for this format: Children of Heaven (1997), Majid Majidi's story of two siblings sharing one pair of shoes, and the first Iranian film nominated for an Academy Award. Review in English first, then in Farsi. Short, simple, and an easy verdict this time: loved it. قسمت اول: بچه‌های آسمان ساخته مجید مجیدی. مرور کوتاه به دو زبان.
